about: Rules the curators gave for placing structures in a subfamily. Each rule names a subfamily exactly as mpstruc does (it is matched by name; the key is recorded for reference) and quotes the curator's sentence. 'barrelStrands' is the number of strands of the membrane beta-barrel a member typically has; 'tolerance' is how far a counted number may be from it and still fit. Add a rule by adding an item; other criteria can be added as new fields. Used by mpstruc/automation.py (placement) and shown on the site (data/curator_rules.json is a copy).
